text:
The plate holds rice topped with a saucy meat-and-vegetable stir-fry that looks like beef or pork with green peppers and carrots. It is on a small compostable plate about 9 inches across.

I estimate about 100 g of rice and about 150 g of meat, vegetables, and sauce, so roughly 250 g of food in total.

Calories: the rice is about 130 kcal per 100 g, so about 130 kcal. The meat and sauce dish is about 150 kcal per 100 g, so about 225 kcal. That gives roughly 355 kcal, which I round up to about 380 to allow for oil in the sauce.

{"kcal": 380, "mass_g": 250}
